        ("c1", 2): Page((item("C"),), "c2"),

@pytest.mark.parametrize("account", ["treasury", "ops", "retail"])
def test_short_page_with_cursor_keeps_walking(account):
    feed = ScriptedFeed(short_middle_page())
    rows = InventoryClient(feed).list_available(account)
    assert [row.sku for row in rows] == ["A", "B", "C", "D", "E"]
